svg.title: Nine forests of state a|c|e
svg.desc: A grid of three choices on the left: the empty set, ab, bc; and three on the right: the empty set, cd, de. There is one edgeless forest, four with one edge, and four with two edges. The last four are groves.

g.text: Rows: choices on a-b-c. Columns: choices on c-d-e. All weights are 1.
Purple: an internal component. Dashed line: an unselected edge.
